name: JEE Main (Joint Entrance Examination Main)
purpose: Admission to B.Tech/B.Arch programs at NITs, IIITs, CFTIs, and qualifying examination for JEE Advanced.
eligibility: 10+2 passed or appearing with Physics, Mathematics, and Chemistry/Biology/Technical Vocational subject.
timeline_status: Session 1 in January, Session 2 in April (Annual cycle)
application_window: November - December for Session 1; February - March for Session 2
exam_pattern: CBT mode, 90 questions (attempt 75), 300 marks total. MCQs and Numerical Value questions.

name: JEE Advanced
conducting_body: One of the 7 Zonal IITs (under Joint Admission Board - JAB)
purpose: Exclusive gateway for B.Tech, BS, Dual Degree programs across all 23 Indian Institutes of Technology (IITs).
eligibility: Top 2,50,000 successful candidates from JEE Main + 75% aggregate in 12th Board (65% for SC/ST/PwD) or in top 20 percentile.
application_window: Opens right after JEE Main Session 2 results in late April / early May
exam_pattern: Two mandatory Computer Based papers (Paper 1 & Paper 2) on the same day. Highly conceptual problem-solving.

name: NEET UG (National Eligibility cum Entrance Test)
purpose: Single uniform entrance examination for admission to MBBS, BDS, BAMS, BUMS, BHMS, and B.Sc Nursing seats nationwide.
eligibility: 10+2 passed or appearing with Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology, and English. Minimum 17 years of age.
timeline_status: Conducted on the first Sunday of May annually
exam_pattern: Pen and Paper (OMR) mode. 200 questions (attempt 180), 720 marks total. +4 for correct, -1 for incorrect.

name: State EAPCET / EAMCET (Engineering, Agriculture & Pharmacy Common Entrance Test)
conducting_body: State Council of Higher Education (APSCHE / TGCHE)
purpose: Admission to 1st year B.Tech, B.Pharm, B.Sc Agriculture, Pharm.D across all university and affiliated colleges in the State.
eligibility: 10+2 with MPC (for Engineering/Tech) or BiPC (for Agri/Pharmacy/Biotech). Minimum 45% marks (40% for reserved).
exam_pattern: Computer Based Test (CBT), 160 questions, 160 marks, 3 hours duration. No negative marking.

name: State ECET (Engineering Common Entrance Test for Diploma & B.Sc)
conducting_body: State Council of Higher Education (APSCHE / TGCHE)
purpose: Lateral entry admission directly into 2nd year (3rd semester) B.Tech / B.E. / B.Pharmacy in state colleges.
eligibility: 3-Year Diploma in Engineering/Technology or B.Sc (Maths) with minimum 45% marks (40% for reserved).
exam_pattern: Computer Based Test, 200 questions, 200 marks, 3 hours. Direct 2nd year seat allotment via web counselling.

name: State POLYCET (Polytechnic Common Entrance Test)
conducting_body: State Board of Technical Education & Training (SBTET AP / Telangana)
purpose: Admission into 3-Year Engineering & Non-Engineering Diploma courses in government, aided, and private polytechnic colleges.
eligibility: Passed or appearing in SSC / 10th Class examination with Mathematics and Science.
exam_pattern: Offline OMR test, 120 questions, 120 marks, 2 hours duration. No negative marking.

name: CUET UG (Common University Entrance Test Undergraduate)
purpose: Single window admission to undergraduate programs in Central Universities (DU, BHU, JNU, JMI, AMU) and participating state/private universities.
eligibility: 10+2 passed or appearing from any recognized board in India.
exam_pattern: Hybrid (CBT & OMR) mode, multiple choice questions based on NCERT Class 12 syllabus.

name: CAT (Common Admission Test)
purpose: Admission to Post-Graduate Programs in Management (MBA / PGDM) across all 21 IIMs and over 1,200 non-IIM institutions.
eligibility: Bachelor Degree with at least 50% marks or equivalent CGPA (45% for SC, ST, and PwD). Final year students eligible.
timeline_status: Conducted on the last Sunday of November annually
exam_pattern: Computer Based Test, 66 questions, 198 marks, 120 minutes (40 minutes per section with sectional timer).

name: CLAT (Common Law Admission Test)
purpose: Admission to 5-Year Integrated BA/BBA LLB (UG) and 1-Year LLM (PG) programs at 24 participating National Law Universities.
eligibility: UG: 10+2 passed with minimum 45% marks (40% for SC/ST). No upper age limit.
timeline_status: Conducted on the first Sunday of December annually
exam_pattern: Pen & Paper (OMR) mode, 120 comprehension-based questions, 120 marks, 2 hours. Negative marking -0.25.

name: UPSC NDA & NA Examination
purpose: Selection of candidates for the Army, Navy, and Air Force wings of National Defence Academy and Indian Naval Academy course.
eligibility: 12th pass (Army) or 12th with Physics & Maths (Air Force/Navy). Unmarried candidates aged 16.5 to 19.5.
important_subjects: General Ability Test (English 200 M + GK/Science 400 M)
timeline_status: Conducted twice a year (NDA I in April, NDA II in September)
application_window: NDA I: December - January; NDA II: May - June
exam_pattern: Offline written exam (900 marks total) followed by 5-Day SSB testing (900 marks).

name: BITSAT (BITS Admission Test)
conducting_body: Birla Institute of Technology and Science (BITS Pilani)
purpose: Admission to Integrated First Degree programmes (B.E., M.Sc.) at BITS Pilani, Goa, and Hyderabad campuses.
eligibility: 12th pass with minimum 75% aggregate in PCM/PCB with at least 60% in each subject.
timeline_status: Session 1 in May, Session 2 in June
exam_pattern: CBT mode, 130 questions, 390 marks. Bonus 12 questions available if candidate completes 130 questions within time.
